configurations.name: mobile-web
runtimeArgs: cd apps/mobile && exec npx expo start --web --port 8081

configurations.name: mobile-web-any-port
runtimeArgs: cd apps/mobile && exec npx expo start --web --port "$PORT"

configurations.name: mobile-ios
runtimeArgs: cd apps/mobile && exec npx expo start --ios --port 8081

configurations.name: mobile-web-mock
runtimeArgs: cd apps/mobile && EXPO_PUBLIC_API_MODE=mock exec npx expo start --web --port "$PORT"

configurations.name: mobile-web-mock-watch
runtimeArgs: cd apps/mobile && EXPO_PUBLIC_API_MODE=mock exec npx expo start --web --port "$PORT"
